name: Log4Shell exploitation evidence
hypothesis: External-facing Java services in our environment were probed or successfully exploited via CVE-2021-44228 between 2021-12 and 2022-03. We expect to see anomalous outbound LDAP / RMI / DNS traffic from those services to attacker-controlled infrastructure during the window, plus suspicious Java process spawns post-exploitation.
